notes: «ابن، بشار» is one man written with a comma (rule 7).
The shared tail is written once after «قالا» for both branches (rule 3, as in the worked example 1).
«وفي حديث خالد عن قتادة سمعت أنسا» names a different transmitter for the same saying: a variant group, never a route. Wording remarks (فرسا لنا، لأبي طلحة) are left out.
